title: Incorporating Machine-Others: An Enactive Exploration of Human-LLM Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2610.39869v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: New concepts based in interactional thinking are required to understand how humans are changed by relating to LLMs. Standard theories of technological impact upon users' autonomy are inadequate here, because this technology is capable of inducing linguistic interactions with humans in an unprecedented manner. Traditional theories of social cognition also fall short, because LLMs have neither autonomy nor minds nor sociality as such. And yet, humans interact, talk, and create with them. We base ourselves on enactive theory, particularly on the theory of Linguistic Bodies and recent developments of enactive accounts of AI, to explore how we make sense with machines. We argue that we incorporate machine-others in two ways: in the tool-like sense of incorporation as enabling particular skills, but also in the more linguistic and identity-tied sense of incorporating (and incarnating) LLMs' ways of languaging. translated_title: 将机器他者纳入自身：基于生成认知理论的人与大语言模型交互探索
translated_abstract: 需要基于交互性思维的新概念，才能理解人类如何因与大语言模型（LLM）建立关系而发生改变。关于技术对用户自主性影响的标准理论在此并不充分，因为这项技术能够以前所未有的方式引发与人类的语言交互；传统的社会认知理论同样存在不足，因为大语言模型既没有自主性，也没有心智，更谈不上真正的社会性。然而，人类却与它们交互、交谈并进行创作。我们以生成认知理论为基础，特别是“语言身体”理论以及生成式人工智能论述的最新发展，来探索我们如何与机器共同创造意义。我们认为，人类以两种方式将机器他者纳入自身：其一是工具意义上的“纳入”，即通过纳入而获得特定技能；其二是更具语言性、与身份认同紧密相关的意义上的纳入——即纳入（并体现）大语言模型的语言化方式。然而，大语言模型本身……
tldr: 本文基于生成认知理论提出，人类以两种方式将大语言模型这一“机器他者”纳入自身——既作为工具以获得特定技能，也在语言与身份认同层面纳入并体现其“语言化”方式，从而揭示人机交互如何改变人类自身。
en_tdlr: Grounded in enactive theory, this paper argues that humans incorporate LLMs as "machine-others" in two ways—tool-like incorporation that enables particular skills, and a more linguistic, identity-tied incorporation (and incarnation) of LLMs' ways of languaging—to explain how relating to LLMs transforms humans.
